title: Japan Couple Getaway | From Timeless Temples to Thrilling Theme Parks
highlights: Embark on an immersive journey across Japan, where ancient temples, bustling cities, natural wonders, and poignant historical landmarks create a rich cultural journey that stays with you forever.
Observe the unexpected at Jigokudani, where snow monkeys soak in natural hot springs, blending wildlife and nature in one of Japan’s most heartwarming sights.
Uncover centuries of spirituality at Zenkoji Temple, where sacred relics, wooden halls, and candlelit passageways draw you into Japan’s deep-rooted Buddhist heritage.
Stand in silent reflection before the Atomic Bomb Dome, a haunting skeletal structure that endures as a UNESCO World Heritage Site and symbol of resilience.
Feel the thrill at Universal Studios Japan, where cinematic worlds like Harry Potter and Super Nintendo come alive through immersive rides and cutting-edge attractions.
overview:
About the Tour:
Embark on a captivating journey across Japan, blending age-old traditions with cutting-edge experiences. Begin in Tokyo, exploring iconic landmarks like Meiji Shrine and Sensoji Temple before venturing to Mount Fuji’s scenic 5th Station. Then, travel to Nagano to witness snow monkeys at Jigokudani and savor local sake at a traditional brewery. Also, ride the sleek Shinkansen to Kyoto, where you’ll stay in a ryokan and visit cultural treasures like Fushimi Inari and Arashiyama. In Osaka, marvel at the grandeur of Osaka Castle and enjoy the thrills of Universal Studios Japan. Conclude with a stunning day trip to Hiroshima and soak-in the spiritual charm of Miyajima Island.

know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each guest at the time of booking and also upon arrival. PAN card will not be considered a valid address proof.
All international participants will have to share passport and visa details on arrival.
Learn basic Japanese phrases like "Konnichiwa" (hello) and "Arigatou" (thank you).
﻿﻿Remove your shoes when entering someone's house, a traditional house, or a temple in Japan.
Always remember not to leave chopsticks upright in a bowl of rice, as it's considered disrespectful.
Using your phone for calls during a train or bus journey is considered inappropriate etiquette in Japan.

The cancellation terms for any bookings or packages will be governed by the specific cancellation policy related to the land package. This means that any cancellations must adhere to the terms and conditions outlined in the land package's cancellation policy.

Thrillophilia's visa policy emphasizes that the company is not liable or responsible for any issues related to visa applications. This includes situations where a visa is rejected or delayed, or if there are any delays or errors in the documentation process. The responsibility and control over visa matters lie solely with the respective embassy.
Guests must note that entry ticket to Todai-ji Temple requires a separate fee of ¥600 per person, payable directly at the entrance.
For all the activities that have a designated common meet and drop point, guests are responsible for arranging their own transportation to and from the location.

Kindly note that hotel taxes range from JPY 500–1,000 per person per day for five-star hotels, JPY 200 per person per day for four-star hotels, and JPY 100 per person per day for three-star hotels and below.
Ensure your luggage does not exceed 160 cm in total dimensions to comply with size restrictions while travelling via bullet train.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Japan! Upon landing at Narita International Airport, get driven to your hotel. After checking in, spend the rest of your day soaking in Tokyo’s charm. You can head out and browse high-end boutiques in Ginza, Tokyo’s luxury shopping paradise or witness a live Samurai Theater performance. Also, you can relax amid the natural beauty of Yoyogi Park or soak in the vibrant atmosphere of the Shibuya Crossing, the world’s busiest pedestrian intersection.

items.title: Check-in at Shinjuku Washington Hotel Annex

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, head to Love Sculpture in Shinjuku & board the transfer for the city's tour. Visit Meiji Jingu, Tokyo’s significant Shinto shrine, & the Imperial Palace the residence of Japan’s royal family. Continue to the historic Sensoji Temple, the city’s oldest Buddhist temple, & stroll through Nakamise-dori Street, lined with traditional shops. Also, enjoy shopping at Akihabara, the famous electric town, before getting driven to Shinjuku St. West Exit. From there, return to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour - Departure from Shinjuku LOVE Statue (With Lunch)

days.title: Trip to Mt. Fuji 5th Station, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets
days.desc: In the morning, proceed to the Shinjuku Center Building & board your transfer for a scenic day trip. First, ascend to Mt. Fuji’s 5th Station, where panoramic views and crisp mountain air offer a memorable experience. Then, shop luxury brands at Gotemba Premium Outlets. Continue to Hakone for a thrilling ride on the Hakone Ropeway, soaring over the steaming Ōwakudani Volcanic Valley. Later, enjoy a scenic pirate ship cruise on Lake Ashi before getting driven to JR Shinjuku Station's West Exit.

items.title: Trip to Mt Fuji 5th Station, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets

days.title: Transfer to Nagano | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Post checkout, head to Tokyo Station to board the bullet train to Nagano, a charming city cradled by the Japanese Alps. After arriving, head to your hotel and check in. Later, spend the day at leisure, where you can relax or explore the city on your own. You can visit the Togakushi-Jinja Shrine, hidden within cedar forests and known for its stunning architecture or explore Matsumoto-jō Castle, one of Japan’s few original samurai-era castles, famed for its dramatic black façade.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

days.title: Snow Monkeys, Zenkoji Temple & Sake Day Trip
days.desc: Today, board your transfer for an amazing day trip. Start with a visit to Zenkoji Temple, one of Japan’s most significant pilgrimage destinations & home to a revered hidden Buddha statue. Then, visit Nishinomon-Yoshinoya Sake Brewery to discover the art of sake-making, complete with tastings of their finely crafted local brews. Later, witness a one-of-a-kind spectacle at Jigokudani Monkey Park, where Japanese snow monkeys soak in steaming hot springs amid dramatic snow-covered cliffs.

items.title: Snow Monkeys, Zenkoji Temple & Sake Day Trip

days.title: Transfer to Kyoto | Day at Leisure
days.desc: After checkout, head to Nagano Station to board the iconic Shinkansen bullet train to Kyoto—an exhilarating ride reaching speeds up to 320 km/h, blending comfort with sweeping countryside views. Upon arrival, get driven to your hotel and check in for an authentic experience at a traditional ryokan stay. Spend the day at your leisure, where you can explore the historic Kyoto Imperial Palace or stroll through the lantern-lit alleys of Gion, renowned for its timeless wooden architecture.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

items.title: Check-in at Kyoto Ryokan Gion Sano

days.title: Kyoto, Nara & Arashiyama Sightseeing Tour | Arashiyama Sagano Train Experience
days.desc: Embark on a drive to Kyoto St. exit & hop on a bus for a day tour. Explore Nara Park, where free-roaming deer welcome you & Fushimi Inari Taisha, famous for its thousands of red torii gates. Then, get driven to Kyoto Station & take the train to Torokko Saga Station for Sagano Scenic Railway experience, gliding past the stunning Hozugawa River. Disembark at Arashiyama & wander through the lush green Bamboo Grove & admire the vibrant artistry of the Kimono Forest. Later, get driven back.

items.title: Kyoto & Nara Sightseeing Tour - Departure from Kyoto

days.title: Transfer to Osaka | Osaka Walking Tour
days.desc: Check out & get driven to Kyoto St. to board the bullet train to Osaka. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel. Later, meet at Exit 2 of Tanimachi 4-Chome St. to begin Osaka Walking Tour. Visit Osaka Castle, famed for its striking architecture, & Koreatown, known for its lively street culture. Also, explore Tennoji Ward to see Abeno Harukas, offering sweeping views that extend to Kobe & Shinsekai, known for its colorful neon lights. End at Dotonbori, where you can savor Osaka’s famous street foods.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

items.title: Check-in at APA Hotel Shin Osaka Ekimae

days.title: Day Trip to Universal Studios
days.desc: Set off for an action-packed day at Universal Studios Japan, one of Japan’s most popular theme parks. Immerse yourself in the world of The Wizarding World of Harry Potter, where you can wander through Hogsmeade Village, sip on butterbeer, and experience thrilling attractions like Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey. Also, step into Super Nintendo World & join Mario & friends in exciting adventures. As evening approaches, soak in the vibrant atmosphere before being driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Hiroshima & Miyajima Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, get driven to Shin-Osaka Station & board the train to Hiroshima. Upon arrival, begin exploring this historically significant city. Visit the Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park, the Atomic Bomb Dome, & the Peace Memorial Museum—all reminders of the city's past. Then, hop on a ferry to Miyajima Island. Once there, marvel at the iconic floating Torii gate & soak in the beauty of the Itsukushima Shrine. Later, return to the station & board the train back to Osaka, followed by a drive to the hotel.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out from your hotel in Osaka and get driven to Kansai International Airport for your flight back home. As you head home, cherish the unforgettable memories of your romantic escape—where serene shrines, scenic train rides, snowy mountains, and vibrant cityscapes blended seamlessly to craft a journey filled with wonder, discovery, and togetherness.
